state.$description: State layer opacities. The layer takes the color of the content (the on-* role), and only one layer is shown at a time.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows hover, focus, press, drag and disabled differently from each other.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Opacities used by a design system's RULES to compute state colors (hover, focus, press, drag, disabled). Components do not read these directly: they read their own per-state tokens.
rules: To change how hover looks everywhere, change the opacity here or replace the pattern rule in your layer; do not restyle components.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: An opacity is a proportion; no dial scales it.
